name: bundle_open_forged_opens_with_the_key
description: Mallory re-encrypts her own text under the published K_obj as her own comment, copying the nonce and commitment: the key alone opens it (the AD is public). This is why a reader uses a key only for the document its entry names by $id (bundle_read_forged_copy_not_covered), and why members, who derive K_obj from her AD, refuse it (mixed_doc_open__forged_after_reveal_refused).
